architecture: unchanged ANS global-goal/local-action hierarchy and OV-SDF, STGHP, RPN-UQ, IGCR interfaces
historical_result_policy: preserve V10.3 as a direction-support result; use V10.3.1 for the corrected observed-gain feedback rerun
correction: consume each paid action's predicted radar/camera yield with the next accepted actual observation for V10.3 and V10.3.1
online_information_constraint: planning and feedback use accumulated sensor observations only; simulator truth is evaluator-only

metrics.inspection_joint: new evaluator-visible surface area in m2 times terminal global F1@5cm; an inspection composite, not 2D coverage or precision gain
metrics.coverage_quality_joint_fraction: terminal reachable-cell coverage fraction times terminal global F1@5cm
metrics.coverage_quality_joint_area: terminal reachable covered area in m2 times terminal global F1@5cm
metrics.new_surface_local_quality: recall and completeness distance on the fixed reference points newly visible after the shared prefix; no local precision claim

mechanism_gates.feedback_full: 48 observed actions, zero pending predictions, and updated posterior in every feedback-enabled branch
mechanism_gates.feedback_disabled: 48 outcomes recorded, zero pending predictions, and alpha/beta remain at the prior
mechanism_gates.safety: zero collisions, no failed termination, safe return

efficacy_gate: report S against G, N, X, and S_no_feedback without changing the frozen scene set or thresholds; a failed comparison remains a negative result
scope: development-domain correction and mechanism evidence; no held-out or universal superiority claim
